title: Simulator shows on the Part Sale Matrix tab too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with Separate Part Sale pricing on, Default on Markup % 50 on the Work Order Matrix and Markup % 20 on the Part Sale Matrix, one range from $0.00 on each.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens on the Work Order Matrix tab.
  • Default's simulator price reads $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00).

Step 3:

  • The Price Part Simulator shows under the Part Sale grid too.
  • Default's simulator price now reads $120.00, from the Part Sale side ($100.00 × 1.20 = $120.00).
